name: ai-status-bar
description: Track Codex and Claude Code usage in the VS Code status bar.

aiStatusBar.pollSeconds.description: How often to poll agent usage APIs, in seconds.

aiStatusBar.barCells.description: Number of segments in each status-bar progress bar.

aiStatusBar.showWeekly.description: Show the secondary weekly or billing-cycle usage bar in each agent status item. The primary 5-hour or daily bar is otherwise always shown.

aiStatusBar.replacePrimaryWithWeeklyOnLi.description: When the secondary weekly or billing-cycle limit is reached, show that exhausted budget in the primary status-bar slot instead of the 5-hour or daily budget.

enumDescriptions: Use each agent's native display style.
Show used percentage and gauge segments for all agents.
Show remaining percentage and gauge segments for all agents.
aiStatusBar.presentationMode.description: Whether usage gauges display used or remaining percentage.

enumDescriptions: Show only the agent name, for example "Claude: ...".
Show only the agent's brand icon, dropping the name.
Show the brand icon followed by the agent name.
aiStatusBar.agentNameStyle.description: How each agent is identified at the start of its status-bar item.

enumDescriptions: Show a gauge and percentage for each usage window.
Show only the percentage for each usage window, without gauges.
aiStatusBar.statusBarStyle.description: How much detail each agent's status-bar item shows. Does not affect the hover tooltip.

aiStatusBar.cautionAt.description: Used percentage at which the status dot turns yellow.

aiStatusBar.warnAt.description: Used percentage at which the status dot turns red and a warning popup can appear.

aiStatusBar.locale.description: BCP-47 locale for dates/times, for example de-DE. Empty means system locale.

enumDescriptions: Show reset times as a clock time or date, for example 14:30.
Show reset times as a countdown, for example "in 2h 15m".
Show both the countdown and the clock time or date.
aiStatusBar.resetTimeFormat.description: How reset times are displayed in the hover tooltip and sidebar panel. The locale setting only affects the absolute part.

aiStatusBar.claude.enabled.description: Enable or disable Claude detection and status display.

aiStatusBar.codex.enabled.description: Enable or disable Codex detection and status display.

aiStatusBar.codex.command.description: Codex command or executable path used to start `codex app-server`.

scripts.bump:minor:compile: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run compile
scripts.bump:patch:compile: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run compile
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs" ".vscode/**/*.json" ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" package.json taskdev.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs" ".vscode/**/*.json" ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" package.json taskdev.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs
